factual_claims.claim: Nordic Fibreboard AS’s financial performance weakened in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: Consolidated net sales decreased 3.4% to €7.33 million from €7.59 million in 2024. EBITDA turned negative €420 thousand from negative €25 thousand. Net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million.

factual_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue declined 3.4% to €7.33 million from €7.59 million in 2024, with fibreboard sales accounting for virtually all revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Consolidated net sales for 2025 were € 7.33 million, which is a decrease of 3.4% compared to 2024 sales of € 7.59 million.' Table: Fibreboards production and sales €7,325k (2025) vs €7,567k (2024).

candidate_sentences.text: Consolidated revenue declined 3.4% to €7.33 million from €7.59 million in 2024, with fibreboard sales accounting for virtually all revenue.

factual_claims.claim: Sales within the European Union, which represented 92% of total revenue, remained relatively stable, while sales to Africa, Asia and the Middle East decreased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Groups' Revenue by Regions table: EU €6,702k (92%) vs €6,921k (91%) in 2024; Africa €200k vs €305k; Asia €161k vs €212k; Middle East €96k vs €139k.

candidate_sentences.text: Sales within the European Union, which represented 92% of total revenue, remained relatively stable, while sales to Africa, Asia and the Middle East decreased.

factual_claims.claim: Real estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand following the termination of rental agreements in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Sales revenue from real estate management was € 3 thousand (2024: € 25 thousand).' Real Estate Management section: 'The sales revenue decreased due to the termination of rental agreements in August 2024.'

candidate_sentences.text: Real estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand following the termination of rental agreements in 2024.
